source.rule: Accepted parent selects G09-NC-B for BASIC with physical POS-B omitted from one-leaf selected series RBD and in NC set QTYNC1 USERT1. Manual p200 describes relative use at block levels, and pp453-454 describe NC-set item USERT; test zero versus one only. Native event log does not print selected NCID or rate.

pre_run_hypotheses: Both arms convert with zero errors/reviewed diagnostics and exact populated-table roundtrip; native SXO/event log/report are nonempty.

NC-set USERT0 suppresses POS-B ordinary failure exposure during BASIC; USERT1 produces at least one BASIC POS-B failure, classified noncritical under selected NCID/QTYNC1, without immediate BASIC abort. Exact seeded times and later events are empirical.
PAR POS-B remains on accepted G04-OPS/USERT1 and active parallel RBD; inspect its native event and outcome independently.
Reports reconcile missions, failure/repair, 72 aligned System/Stock bins, no stock movement and terminal readiness.
native_acceptance: Two immutable guarded serial session-0 SSH runs with host mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen parent/source fingerprints and 13 raw SHA-256 seals each.
Exact populated-table roundtrips, zero converter errors, reviewed diagnostics, nonempty native output, exact event/mission/repair/report/ledger reconciliation.
Independent read-only replay of source-bound NC-set usage contrast; selected NCID and rate are not claimed as native-printed.
diagnostic_gate: If zero arm has a BASIC B fault, full arm has none, or full BASIC B fault is critical and aborts, retain runs as diagnostic and revise under a new version/run ID without changing this contract.
limits: Only zero versus one NC-set USERT at QTYNC1 on one omitted physical POS-B selected in BASIC, one seed/replication, common near-zero A rate. No fractional/more-than-one NC usage, other quantities, set overlaps, hierarchy, rate law, operation-dependent PM, GUI visuals or cross-engine parity.
Parent-to-panel changes common A FRQ; only within-panel B NC-set USERT and description differ. Interpret selected rate through frozen source, manual and roundtrip, not a native log rate field.
